title: 档案室钥匙：旧版 Shot Prompt 分层缺失
selection_reason: Existing V1.2 acceptance fixture with stable assets, a 9-second VIDEO, two shots, dialogue timing, continuity state and legacy shot-level generation prompts.

material_changes.change: V9 adds one complete VIDEO master prompt instead of relying on child shot prompts.
The push-in is tied to revealing the key/eyeline relationship rather than style-only movement.
Audio and lip-sync remain external under the fixed endpoint profile.

videos.video_negative_prompt: Do not change the character, wardrobe, door position, key material, or screen direction.

shots.shot_delta_prompt: EVE inserts the brass key into the old lock under warm side light; slowly push in as she suppresses fear and finally looks outside the door.
shots.local_exclusions: Do not add jewelry, change the hairstyle, add people, or change the door or key.

shots.shot_delta_prompt: EVE presses the archive against her chest and speaks quietly after hearing footsteps; keep the door gap in the foreground under warm side light while she controls her fear.
shots.local_exclusions: Do not change wardrobe stains, key position, body orientation, or the door's left-side spatial relation.

director_shots.narrative_purpose: EVE 在危险逼近前尝试开启档案。
director_shots.performance_transition: 紧张 → 强迫自己稳定
director_shots.shot_size_composition: 中近景，EVE 右侧，门在左侧
director_shots.cut_motivation: 钥匙进入锁孔并完成第一动作节点

director_shots.narrative_purpose: 脚步声迫使 EVE 做出行动决定。
director_shots.performance_transition: 警觉 → 压低声音下定决心

videos.video_master_prompt: VIDEO-01. Midnight underground archive room beneath the palace. Use CHAR-01, LOOK-01A, SET-01, and PROP-01. 0–4s: EVE stands on the right side facing the iron door on the left, inserts the brass key into the old lock with her right hand, and her fingers turn pale from tension; slowly push in from a medium close-up to connect the lock action with her alert eyeline. 4–9s: keep the key in the lock as footsteps approach outside; EVE presses the archive against her chest and quietly says "I made a promise." Hold the door gap in the left foreground with a locked camera; end as she prepares to step back. Keep the warm wall lamp and rainy-night reflections continuous. Audio and lip-sync are handled by the external post-production chain.
videos.video_negative_prompt: Do not change CHAR-01 identity, LOOK-01A, the SET-01 door position, PROP-01 material, or the key state; do not add people; do not reverse the established screen direction; do not add camera movement not approved by Stage 07.

shots.shot_delta_prompt: 0–4s: EVE inserts PROP-01 into the lock with her right hand; her fingers turn pale as the medium close-up slowly pushes toward the lock and her alert eyeline.
shots.local_exclusions: Do not change wardrobe, move the door, release the key, or duplicate the key.

shots.shot_delta_prompt: 4–9s: keep the key in the lock; after footsteps approach, EVE presses the archive to her chest and quietly says "I made a promise." Hold the door gap in the left foreground with a locked camera.
shots.local_exclusions: Do not change the key state, body orientation, LOOK-01A, or SET-01 spatial relation.

director_shots.narrative_purpose: 用钥匙动作建立她主动冒险的选择。
director_shots.performance_transition: 紧张 → 强迫自己稳定
director_shots.shot_size_composition: 中近景，EVE 右侧，门在左侧
director_shots.movement_motivation: 从人物状态推进到钥匙/视线信息，强化危险即将被打开。
director_shots.cut_motivation: 钥匙进入锁孔，动作节点完成并转入外部威胁。

director_shots.narrative_purpose: 让脚步声触发决定并完成对白承诺。
director_shots.performance_transition: 警觉 → 压住恐惧 → 下定决心
director_shots.movement_motivation: 无运镜，稳定画面让脚步和面部反应成为主要变化。
director_shots.cut_motivation: 对白结束并形成下一动作的准备状态。
